node.title: Musical Moler Bear
node.description: Our plush, super soft sweet-tooth sidekick is the perfect snuggle buddy and sleep aid. Your child's furry friend helps lull restless kiddos to sleep with melatonin-activating amber lights, which stay on for 13 minutes — the average amount of time it takes for kids to fall asleep. When the sun rises and it's time to brush in the morning, Moler also plays two SuperMouth songs to inspire boogie brush time and get your kid's day started right! DETAILS: Click the right leg to activate melatonin with amber lights (it stays on for 13 minutes). Click the left leg to play a two-minute SuperMouth song so kids don't rush when they brush. Give Moler's tag a sniff - kids will love the bubble gum smell. recommended for ages: 2+ years

node.title: SuperMouth Nano-Hydroxyapatite with Fluoride Mouthwash
node.description: SuperMouth’s fluoride mouthwash is the ultimate companion for a healthy, vibrant smile. Expertly formulated to provide long-lasting protection, this mouthwash features an alkaline pH of 8.5, which helps support a balanced oral environment. Unlike typical mouthwashes, ours is free from alcohol, antiseptics, and potent essential oils that could disrupt the delicate balance of your oral microbiome. Instead, it’s enriched with prebiotics like inulin to nurture beneficial microbes and our Hydroxamin complex to support enamel health. With a rich, non-watered down formula, it helps to coat your teeth for lasting freshness and protection while reaching areas that a toothbrush might miss. And with four delicious flavors to choose from, maintaining your oral health has never tasted so good. Key Features: Fluoride Protection: Helps prevent cavities by strengthening enamel and protecting against decay. Hydroxamin Complex: Contains nano-hydroxyapatite, vitamin D3, and vitamin K2 to support enamel health and enhance overall tooth strength. Prebiotic Support: Enriched with inulin to nurture beneficial microbes and promote a healthy oral microbiome. Xylitol-Enriched: Helps maintain moisture and promotes a balanced oral environment. Alkaline pH: Formulated with a pH of 8.5 to support a healthy oral environment and combat acid attacks. Microbiome-Friendly: Free from alcohol, antiseptics, and potent essential oils that can disrupt the balance of your oral microbiome. Long-Lasting Effect: Non-watered down formula helps to coat teeth for lasting freshness and protection. Comprehensive Coverage: Reaches areas that a toothbrush can miss, ensuring thorough oral care. Delicious Flavors: Available in four delicious flavors, making daily oral care a pleasant experience. Safe & Clean Ingredients: Formulated with pure, effective ingredients for a clean and refreshing mouth. Expertly Formulated: Developed by leading dentists and oral care experts, with a patented formula designed for optimal dental health. No Artificial Additives: Free from artificial flavors, colors, sweeteners, preservatives, SLS, and antibiotics; non-GMO. Global Quality: Made in the USA with premium, globally sourced ingredients. Inclusive Formulation: Gluten-free and paraben-free to cater to all users.

node.title: SuperMouth Mouth Spray
node.description: Managing the health of your mouth is just a spritz away. After meals, snacks, or drinks, your mouth becomes highly acidic for 30-60 minutes, making teeth vulnerable to damage from brushing. Instead, use our daily mouth spray to help restore normal pH levels. This on-the-go solution features a pH balanced formula with an alkaline pH of 8.5 to support a healthy oral environment and protect your oral microbiome. Packed with prebiotics like inulin that feed the “good” bacteria to keep the oral microbiome healthy and reduce odor associated with bad breath, and enriched with xylitol, this dentist-formulated spray is perfect for use anytime, anywhere. pH Balanced: Features an alkaline pH of 8.5 to restore pH levels after eating or drinking, supporting a balanced oral microbiome. Microbiome-Friendly: Includes prebiotics like inulin that feed the “good” bacteria to keep the oral microbiome healthy and reduce bad breath. node.title: SuperMouth Non-Fluoride Nano-Hydroxyapatite Floss
node.description: You wouldn’t brush your teeth without toothpaste, so why floss without it? Our Hydroxamin®* Floss is infused with the same key ingredients as our premium toothpaste, including nano-hydroxyapatite, vitamins D3, and K2, to provide comprehensive oral care. This innovative floss uses patented expanding technology to remove over 40% more plaque than standard flosses** while being gentle on gums and comfortable around fingers. The super soft floss, combined with our patent-pending formulation of Hydroxamin®, effectively cleans hard-to-reach areas, supporting overall oral health and helping to reduce the risk of tooth decay. Available in mouth-watering flavors like mint, vanilla, chocolate, and strawberry, this dentist-formulated and approved floss ensures a superior flossing experience without any of the harsh chemicals found in conventional products. Infused with Hydroxamin: Contains nano-hydroxyapatite, vitamins D3 & K2, along with xylitol to support overall oral health. Patented Expanding Technology: Removes over 40% more plaque than standard flosses** for a deeper clean. No Harsh Chemicals: Free from PFAS/PTFE (Teflon®)/PFOA/BPA, petroleum-based products such as microcrytalline wax, artificial flavors, or colors. Reduces Tooth Decay: Removes plaque and food particles from between teeth to help reduce the risk of tooth decay. Delicious Flavors: Available in mint, vanilla, chocolate, and strawberry. node.title: Adult Tongue Scraper
node.description: Teens and adults, elevate your oral hygiene routine with the SuperMouth® Triple Action Tongue Cleaner, a vital component in the quest for optimal oral health. Tongue cleaning is an often overlooked but crucial practice for maintaining a healthy mouth, as it can significantly reduce the presence of harmful bacteria and debris that contribute to bad breath, dental decay, and other oral health issues. Unlike toothbrush bristles, which are designed for the hard, smooth surfaces of enamel, the tongue’s unique structure and soft surface require specialized tools for effective cleaning. This advanced tool is specifically designed to empower you with professional-grade care, featuring innovative features that ensure a thorough clean and fresh feeling. Embrace this essential tool to maintain optimal oral health and keep your breath fresh every day. Key Features: Specialized Design Brush: Penetrates the fine crevices of your tongue to remove hidden debris, effectively reaching areas that regular toothbrush bristles can’t. Studded Scrubber: Gently exfoliates the tongue’s surface, promoting a healthier oral environment, ideal for the soft and irregular texture of the tongue. Efficient Scraper: Scoops out bad bacteria, fostering a healthy mouth microbiome and freshening your breath, specifically designed for the delicate ecosystem of the tongue.

node.title: Glow Globe Musical Toothbrush
node.description: Super Dentists Dr. HaveOneSuperSmile and Tooth Keri have heard Earth’s calls for help and are here to assist your little super with their toothbrushes. Their soft bristles are gentle on sensitive mouths but pack a serious punch when it comes to removing tartar and build-up on teeth. Dr. HaveOneSuperSmile stands atop his Toothstar planet, while Tooth Keri stands on a mushroom from her fairy forest home between brushings, helping them shine from the inside out, illuminating their powers in the form of star glitter. But beware, lurking within the Glow Globe Toothbrush is Cavitar, the notorious villain, standing atop his henchman Moler’s shoulder. Moler, with his insatiable sweet tooth, delights in the glitter that floats around like candy, while Cavitar desperately seeks a way out of the brush. Together, they create a fun and thrilling brushing experience, encouraging your little one to fight off the plaque villains with every brushstroke! And for an extra dose of excitement, when you remove the brush from its stand, music starts playing, and when you place it back, a red light glows, illuminating the brush. manual toothbrush soft nylon SuperBristles®️ replaceable, easy-to-remove, clear mouthbrush head storage base that lights up the mouthbrush and transports kids into the mesmerizing worlds of ToothStar Planet and Tooth Keri Land base plays four 2-minute songs to motivate kids and extend brushing time (placing brush in the base stops the music - taking it in and out is how you change songs too) replaceable battery (AG 13 button battery) recommended for ages: 2-12 years

Parents can choose between the bare essentials with our Basic System option or the ultimate whole-mouth health option with our Complete System. For mouths in training. This bare essentials mouthcare kit is guaranteed to get the job done. The Basic System offers plain and simple protection for developing mouths. node.title: Wisdom Mouthcare Organizer and UV Cleanser
node.description: Wisdom, aka Mama Turbo, is here to ensure all mouth systems are a-go. Just like other super moms, she is a multi-tasking master. Not only does Wisdom dispense mouthpaste, but her wings store and protect Turbo Twins mouthbrushes (or any other SuperMouth mouthbrushes) from sink germs while UV lights blast off harmful bacteria and cleanse brush heads after each use. Wisdom also sings sweet lullabies to her babies Mini Turbo and Turbo Jr. (sold separately), and your child with four two-minute SuperMouth songs (the recommended time for brushing). Watching kids fulfill their brushing mission makes this mama’s heart skip a beat — or rather, stay in beat — with their favorite toothy tune as they brush. Toothpaste Dispenser: Works with any SuperMouth toothpaste, ensuring a hassle-free brushing routine. Brush Storage: Provides storage for both Turbo Twins mouthbrushes or any other SuperMouth mouthbrushes. Germ Protection: Offers covered protection from sink germs for mouthbrush heads. UV Cleansing: UV system in wings activates for nine minutes, cleansing bristles. Multi-Function Body: Wisdom’s body turns into a rinse cup for added convenience. Brushing Songs: Four two-minute brushing songs sync to the rhythm of Wisdom’s flashing heart, encouraging proper brushing habits. Music Availability: Full versions of the songs, along with the lyrics, can be found on all major online music stores under the album SuperMouth Brush Beats. Elevate your child’s oral care routine with the enchanting and functional Wisdom, making every brushing session a fun and healthy mission!

node.title: Collectible Scented Hand Soap
node.description: Proper handwashing before and after brushing and flossing is essential for overall hygiene and health. However, many commercial soaps contain harsh chemicals and artificial fragrances that can be harmful to children. SuperMouth’s Collectible Scented Hand Soaps offer a safe, naturally-derived alternative, protecting your family’s health while making hygiene engaging. Collectible SuperMouth Characters: Each soap reveals one of nine exciting SuperMouth superheroes or villains, turning handwashing into a playful adventure. Delightful Mild Vanilla Scent: Gentle fragrance kids love, encouraging frequent handwashing. Safe, Naturally Derived Ingredients: Ranked #1 by the Environmental Working Group (EWG), crafted without harsh chemicals or artificial additives for maximum safety. Promotes Healthy Habits: Regular use encourages frequent handwashing, seamlessly fitting into your child’s daily hygiene and oral care routines. Mess-Free and Long-Lasting: Designed for easy handling, these soaps stay clean and dry between uses, reducing mess and waste. Inspired by Toothstar: Superhero-themed designs connect handwashing with the engaging SuperMouth universe, promoting consistent hand hygiene in a kid-friendly way. Ideal Companion: Pair with the Soap-a-Hero Handwashing Station to further encourage good hygiene practices, making cleanliness fun for kids. Tip: These collectible soaps aren’t just for hands—or even just for kids! The whole family can enjoy them as a fun and effective total body wash. Recommended for ages 4+ years.

node.title: SuperMouth Nano-Hydroxyapatite with Fluoride Floss – Ortho Floss
node.description: Orthodontic patients, say hello to an ortho floss of heroic proportions. SuperMouth Ortho Floss uses patented expanding technology that clears away 40% more plaque than basic flosses** and includes a handy threader to make navigating the hardware in your mouth and cleaning between teeth a breeze! Plus, to help prevent cavities and decalcification, our orthodontic floss is designed thicker and deposits a stronger blend of Hydroxamin® and fluoride to clean and protect every inch of the mouth. Whether you have braces, other orthodontic devices, bridges, or implants, this floss is uniquely designed to clean around brackets and wires, and even under bridges and implants where cleaning is often difficult. Includes built-in floss threader Expands between teeth Uniquely designed to clean around braces, other orthodontic devices, bridges, and implants Includes key ingredients: fluoride, nano-hydroxyapatite, vitamins K2 and D3, and xylitol No petroleum-based wax, no PFAS/PTFE (Teflon®)/PFOA/BPA; no artificial ingredients Uses safe & natural beeswax * contains nano-hydroxyapatite material, vitamins K2 and D3 ** Genoa University clinical randomized controlled trial. *** All SuperMouth products rank a 1 on the EWG scale.

node.title: Nano-Hydroxyapatite Mouthwash for Braces and Aligners, Suitable for All Ages
node.description: SuperMouth’s Orthodontic Mouthwash is specially designed for children and adults navigating the unique challenges of orthodontic treatment. Unlike most over-the-counter mouthwashes, our formula is free from alcohol, antiseptic or antimicrobial agents, and harsh essential oils that can disrupt your oral microbiome. Instead, it’s enriched with prebiotics like inulin to nurture beneficial microbes while selectively reducing harmful ones, promoting a healthier mouth and fresher breath. With a uniquely alkaline pH of 8.5, our mouthwash helps fight cavities and supports enamel health. It features our Hydroxamin+ complex, which includes even higher levels of nano-hydroxyapatite combined with fluoride, providing superior protection against cavities and decalcifications. Offering a protective coat that lasts long after you rinse, it reaches those hard-to-brush areas, ensuring comprehensive oral care throughout your orthodontic journey. Developed for Orthodontic Care: Formulated specifically for optimal dental health during orthodontic treatment. Orthodontist-Developed: Expertly crafted by specialists to meet the unique needs of orthodontic patients. Hydroxamin+ Formulation: Contains even higher levels of nano-hydroxyapatite, D3 vitamins, and vitamin K2, which works with fluoride to help strengthen enamel and support cavity prevention. Xylitol-Enriched: Helps maintain moisture and promotes a balanced oral environment. Microbiome-Friendly Formula: Contains no alcohol, antiseptics, antimicrobial agents, or potent essential oils, preserving your oral microbiome. Prebiotic Support: Enriched with inulin and other prebiotics to nurture beneficial microbes and selectively reduce harmful ones, promoting overall oral health. Alkaline pH: Uniquely formulated with a pH of 8.5 to help maintain a healthy oral ecosystem. Cavity Prevention: Designed to help strengthen teeth against cavities and decalcifications, essential for those with braces or aligners. Long-Lasting Protection: Non-watered down formula that coats teeth for extended protection and efficacy. Comprehensive Coverage: Reaches and protects areas that a toothbrush can’t, ensuring full mouth care during orthodontic treatment. Safe & Clean Ingredients: Free from harmful chemicals, ensuring a pure, effective clean. No Artificial Additives: Free from artificial flavors, colors, sweeteners, preservatives, SLS, and antibiotics; non-GMO. pH-Balanced: Ideal for helping maintain the natural balance of your oral environment. Inclusive Formulation: Gluten-free and paraben-free to cater to all users. Global Quality: Made in the USA with premium ingredients from around the world.

node.title: Ortho Tongue Scraper
node.description: Orthodontic patients, enhance your oral hygiene routine with the SuperMouth® Triple Action Tongue Cleaner, specially designed to complement your orthodontic care. While tongue cleaning is crucial for everyone, it becomes even more essential when wearing braces or other orthodontic appliances, as they can trap additional food particles and bacteria. This advanced tool is tailored to meet the unique challenges of orthodontic oral hygiene, featuring specialized features that ensure a thorough clean without compromising the integrity of your appliances. Adopt this indispensable tool to maintain optimal oral health and ensure your breath stays fresh throughout your orthodontic journey. Key Features: Specialized Design Brush: Expertly crafted to navigate the fine crevices of your tongue, effectively removing hidden debris and surpassing the capabilities of regular toothbrush bristles. Studded Scrubber: Offers gentle exfoliation of the tongue’s surface, ensuring a healthier oral environment without risking damage to your orthodontic appliances. Efficient Scraper: Designed to safely remove unwanted bacteria, promoting a healthy mouth microbiome and keeping your breath fresh, even with braces or other orthodontic treatments.

node.title: OrthoBrush Manual Toothbrush
node.description: Introducing the OrthoBrush Manual Toothbrush by SuperMouth, the world's first manual orthodontic toothbrush. Leveraging the same groundbreaking technology used in our adult and kids' brushes, this toothbrush is a marvel of innovation and precision. After meticulously scanning thousands of teeth with braces, we've crafted orthodontic toothbrushes that effectively brush and clean around braces. This advanced design addresses the higher risk of cavities and decalcifications - those permanent white or brown marks that can form around brackets if not cleaned thoroughly. Our OrthoBrush is more than just a toothbrush; it is specifically engineered for orthodontic care of braces. The bristles, a never-before-seen invention, glide effortlessly around orthodontic appliances, ensuring a clean that's both deep and gentle. This braces toothbrush isn't just a necessity for orthodontic care; it's a breakthrough in dental hygiene technology. World's first orthodontic-specific manual toothbrush. Cleans up to 23 times better than a manual brush. Patent-pending bristles crafted for braces, cleaning around brackets and wires. Scanned thousands of orthodontic teeth for a perfect, tailored fit. Reduces the risk of cavities and decalcifications in orthodontic patients. Gentle yet effective brushing for optimal orthodontic oral hygiene.

Leveraging the same groundbreaking technology used in our adult and kids' brushes, this toothbrush is a marvel of innovation and precision. After meticulously scanning thousands of teeth with braces, we've crafted bristles that uniquely adapt to and effectively clean around brackets and wires. This advanced design addresses the higher risk of cavities and decalcifications - those permanent white or brown marks that can form around brackets if not cleaned thoroughly.

Our OrthoBrush is more than just a toothbrush; it's a proactive step in maintaining impeccable oral health for those with braces. The bristles, a never-before-seen invention, glide effortlessly around orthodontic appliances, ensuring a clean that's both deep and gentle. This toothbrush isn't just a necessity for orthodontic care; it's a breakthrough in dental hygiene technology.

  • World's first orthodontic-specific manual toothbrush.
  • Cleans up to 30 times better than a manual brush
  • Patent-pending bristles crafted for braces, cleaning around brackets and wires.
  • Scanned thousands of orthodontic teeth for a perfect, tailored fit.
  • Reduces the risk of cavities and decalcifications in orthodontic patients.
  • Gentle yet effective cleaning for optimal orthodontic oral hygiene.

node.title: SuperMouth Orthodontic Toothpaste: Advanced care for Braces & Aligners
node.description: SuperMouth sets a new standard in orthodontic oral care with our patented orthodontic toothpaste, specifically formulated for those undergoing orthodontic treatment. Whether you have braces, aligners like Invisalign, or other orthodontic appliances, our toothpaste ensures your mouth remains clean, protected, and healthy. Our proprietary Hydroxamin+ complex, powered by Liquid Enamel Technology™, addresses the unique challenges of orthodontic treatment, notably increased risks of cavities and decalcification—unsightly white or yellow marks that can form around braces or aligners. Featuring more than 10% nano-hydroxyapatite that is naturally compatible with your tooth structure, along with fluoride, vitamins D3 & K2, this specialized formula strengthens enamel, reduces sensitivity, and supports enamel remineralization. Clinically Proven Protection: Designed specifically for optimal dental health during orthodontic care. Orthodontist-Developed: Expertly crafted by specialists in orthodontic treatment. Liquid Enamel Technology™ (Hydroxamin+ Complex): Proprietary blend of more than 10% nano-hydroxyapatite, fluoride, vitamins D3 & K2 to strengthen enamel, reduce sensitivity, and protect against decalcification. Xylitol-Enriched: Supports moisture retention and promotes a balanced oral environment. Microbiome-Friendly: Free from harsh essential oils, alcohol, and antiseptics, preserving your oral microbiome’s natural balance. Low Abrasivity: Relative Dentin Abrasivity (RDA) of 67 ensures effective cleaning without damaging enamel. pH-Balanced Formula: Helps maintain natural oral equilibrium for lasting freshness. 100% Clean Ingredients: Free from artificial flavors, colors, sweeteners, preservatives, SLS, antibiotics; non-GMO. Prebiotic Support: Includes inulin and other prebiotics to nurture a healthy oral microbiome. Made in the USA: Crafted with premium, globally sourced ingredients. Inclusive and Responsible: Gluten-free and paraben-free to appeal broadly and uphold environmental responsibility. Choosing SuperMouth Orthodontic Toothpaste is an investment in the health, beauty, and longevity of your smile during and after orthodontic treatment.

node.title: Ortho Mouth Spray for Braces and Aligners
node.description: SuperMouth Ortho Mouth Spray is an essential on-the-go solution for maintaining fresh breath and promoting oral health, specifically designed for individuals with braces and aligners. Ideal for both children and adults, this mouth spray is available in irresistible flavors like chocolate, vanilla, strawberry, and mint. It neutralizes bad breath while helping to restore your mouth’s natural pH after meals, snacks, or drinks. Infused with prebiotics like inulin to support a healthy oral microbiome, and featuring xylitol, this dentist-formulated spray is a must-have for your oral care routine. Unlike other mouth sprays, it contains no harsh ingredients that could disrupt the delicate balance of your oral microbiome. Additionally, every ingredient in our formula is ranked #1 on the Environmental Working Group (EWG) scale, ensuring the highest standards of safety and purity. It’s a breath freshener the whole family will love! Key Features: pH-Balanced: Helps restore the mouth’s natural pH balance after eating or drinking, reducing acid buildup that can contribute to dental issues. Xylitol-Enriched: Features xylitol, known for its benefits in supporting oral health. Dentist-Formulated: Expertly developed by leading dentists to ensure the best possible oral care experience. node.title: ULTIM8 SmartBrush System
node.description: Introducing the ULTIM8® SmartBrush® System—the first reinvention of the toothbrush in nearly a century. For decades, traditional toothbrushes have fallen short: they are often too abrasive, causing sensitivity and gum recession; they struggle to clean effectively between teeth, where cavities commonly develop; and they are grossly unhygienic, harboring millions of microbes. That’s why we’ve completely reimagined the toothbrush from the ground up. The ULTIM8 SmartBrush electric toothbrush features patented revolutionary bristles for an unprecedented clean, a pressure sensor to prevent over-brushing, and the groundbreaking SmartHub® with UV sanitizing, drying, and wireless charging for ultimate hygiene. Imagine a rechargeable electric toothbrush so advanced, it feels like you’re visiting the dentist every time you use your toothbrush. Plus, the Travel SmartCase® keeps your toothbrush clean and protected while holding your toothpaste and floss for convenient travel. For the first time, brushing teeth and gums is safer, more effective, and more hygienic—experience the future of oral care today. Why Choose the ULTIM8® SmartBrush Electric Toothbrush System? Innovative Bristles for Superior Cleaning: Patented SuperBristles® Pro technology cleans teeth up to an incredible 40 times better than a manual brush. For those with braces, the SuperBristles® Ortho option ensures thorough cleaning around brackets and wires up to an astonishing 60 times better than a manual toothbrush. Advanced PBT Bristles: Most brushes use nylon bristles that can be harsher on teeth and limit bristle density. Our ultra-soft PBT bristles allow us to pack over 3X more bristles into each brush head, delivering a deeper, more precise clean while being gentler on enamel and gums, especially for those experiencing sensitivity from aggressive brushing. Pressure Sensor: Prevents over-brushing by indicating optimal pressure in real-time, protecting your tooth enamel and gums. Dual Sonic Modes: Customizable cleaning with two sonic toothbrush modes for different levels of intensity and effectiveness. SmartHub®: The patent-pending SmartHub features a built-in UV sanitizer that eliminates 99.9% of germs, an integrated dryer, wireless charging, a convenient rinse cup, and a protective cap all in one, ensuring your electric toothbrush is always hygienic and ready to use. SmartCase®: The travel SmartCase features a wireless charger, UV sanitizer, and custom spaces for SuperMouth’s travel toothpaste and floss, ensuring your oral care routine stays intact. Waterproof and Wireless Charging: Fully waterproof design and wireless SmartMag technology for hassle-free electric toothbrush charging and easy cleaning. Smart Timer: Ensures you brush for the dentist-recommended two minutes every time.

node.descriptionHtml:
Named “Best for Braces” by Health.com — and recognized across leading health and wellness publications — this is the only brush built from the ground up for orthodontic treatment.

Key Benefits at a Glance

✓ SuperBristles® Ortho — patented bristle architecture engineered for braces, ISO-verified up to 60x cleaner than a manual brush around orthodontic hardware

✓ Four sonic brushing modes including dedicated Ortho mode

✓ Pressure sensor to help protect teeth and gums throughout treatment

✓ SmartTimer™ with 30-second quadrant reminders

✓ SmartHub™ UV sanitizing, automatic drying, and wireless charging

✓ SmartCase™ travel UV sanitizing and wireless charging (optional)

✓ System that grows with you — switches to SuperBristles® Pro or Pro-mini after treatment, same brush for life

 

Protect Your Orthodontic Investment

Clinical research shows that between 30% and 50% of orthodontic patients develop white spot lesions during treatment — permanent enamel damage caused by plaque trapped around brackets and wires. Orthodontic patients face elevated cavity risk as well. The right toothbrush doesn’t just clean teeth. During treatment, it actively protects the outcome you’re working toward.

 

Why Choose the ULTIM8® Ortho SmartBrush System?

Patented SuperBristles®Ortho
No bristles before had been engineered to wrap around the three-dimensional geometry of brackets, wires, and attachments — until SuperBristles® Ortho. Three times more bristles than the industry norm. Super-soft PBT bristles that are inherently gentler than nylon and become more adaptive with use rather than splaying. ISO-verified to clean up to 60 times more effectively than a manual brush around orthodontic hardware.

 

Four Sonic Modes + a System That Grows With You
Ortho mode is co-engineered with SuperBristles® Ortho to deliver the full 60x cleaning advantage. Sensitive mode is ideal on tender days after adjustments. After treatment, swap brush heads for SuperBristles® Pro or Pro-mini — same handle, new chapter. Replace brush heads every 6 weeks for optimal performance.

 

Pressure Sensor — Protect What You're Investing In
The real-time pressure sensor indicator light alerts you the moment you’re pressing too hard, protecting enamel and gums throughout treatment. Studies suggest most brushers apply more pressure than recommended. The Ortho SmartBrush makes sure you’re not among them.

 

SmartHub® — Your Brush's Home
After every brush, your ULTIM8 Ortho lives in the SmartHub. UV sanitizer eliminates 99.9% of germs in 5 minutes. Integrated dryer removes moisture between uses. Wireless charging keeps your brush powered. Indicator lights designed to avoid disrupting melatonin production during nighttime bathroom visits.

 

SmartCase® — Traveling Made Easy
Built-in UV sanitizing and wireless charging keep your brush protected and powered on the go. Custom compartments store SuperMouth travel toothpaste and floss. Your full ortho routine, wherever you are.

 

SmartTimer
30-second quadrant vibration pulses ensure every area around your hardware gets equal attention. Auto shut-off after two minutes. Proper technique, made automatic.

 

Waterproof — IPX7 | Designed for All Orthodontic Appliances
Traditional braces, ceramic braces, lingual braces, clear aligners with attachments, expanders, retainers — if orthodontic hardware is part of your daily life, this is your brush.
